# Preserve useful damage from upgraded targeted spells

Sample22 Ring6's actual default235 advice spends input25's ChaosScepter-upgraded
Witchweave18 on3HP Hunter23. The unchanged24-input prefix has Cael10 at1706HP,
two spell weakness stacks and room2 Conduit9. Two independent native component
processes instead target Cael on that input:1706->1616HP, both weakness stacks
consumed and the small enemy unchanged. All25 full successors/forecasts/RNG and
four immutable branches match. This is a component strategy witness, not a win.

Release238 orders targeted fixed enemy damage using prospective room magic
power, visible weakness, useful damage capped by health/armor and threat removal
on a kill. It only reorders cards whose authored/permanent damage already exceeds
the weakest visible enemy's health. Cheap pings retain their existing finishing
order even when temporary room power is high. There is a local per-choice room/
card cache; no shared mutable search state or additional full successor frontier.
Mixed friendly damage, random ranges, abilities and other effect compositions
keep their existing policy. Every legal target remains in the complete search.

The original native root retains its complete old successor/RNG; prospective
values distinguish90 useful damage from3 damage plus removal of7ATK. Both seeds
choose the upgraded spell's useful target after their own legal ability/cheap
card prefix. Eight concurrent choices, ten high/low damage, shield, armor and
fallback controls pass with immutable roots and complete actual effects/RNG.
Existing front/targeted/ability team controls pass. Full default-budget native
campaign acceptance continues separately.

Single/two-worker whole-battle wins, hard node/step limits, expiry/cancellation
and immutable roots also pass within the existing3000ms focused control. The
narrow damage policy preserves the Ring6 bottom route through turn8; its73-input
model result still loses at boss1548HP and is not counted as a strategy win.

Release237's stronger Ring4 opening remains an accepted57-input/Pyre37 pair;
its subsequent Ring5 default47-input/8-EndTurn defeat at boss302HP is retained
separately. A single-battle improvement does not establish a campaign win.
